tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are a member of the neighborhood association, and you have noticed that the local park needs some maintenance. You decide to contact the association president, Mr. Williams, to discuss the issues and offer a suggestion.
Write an email to Mr. Williams. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the maintenance issue you have observed in the park.
Explain why it is important to address the issue.
Make a suggestion for how to deal with the issue.
tasks.to: Mr. Williams Subject: Concern about park maintenance
tasks.subject: Concern about park maintenance
tasks.title: Write an Email
